caption:
Lockhart tests robotic adobe.

Axios Austin reported on November 24 that Terran Robotics has built three prototype homes at Lockhart’s Proto-Town. The company is testing a robot designed to place and compact a mix of soil, water and straw into walls.

At the open house Axios attended, workers operated the robot manually. Whether the approach can reliably build homes at scale, and how the total cost of a finished home compares with conventional construction, are still open questions.

Sources: Axios Austin, November 24, 2026, and Terran Robotics’ process overview.
